title: Development Tribunal decision 23-063: carport with a 0.5 m side boundary setback against QDC MP1.2 boundary clearance (Pelican Waters, Sunshine Coast)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.

document_date: Decision notice dated 13 May 2024 (PDF p. 5); hearing 16 Feb 2024 (p. 1)

facts.text: A dual appeal: against Council's refusal of a development application to extend a dwelling house with a carport, under the dwelling house code of the Sunshine Coast Planning Scheme 2014; and against the certifier's refusal, directed by Council as concurrence agency, under QDC MP1.2.
The proposed Class 10a carport is 16 m long at a 0.5 m setback from the side boundary.
The notice finds a conflict with Acceptable Solution A2(a)(i) of QDC MP1.2, where the side boundary clearance is 1.5 m.
Council's refusal reasons included that the boundary arrangement 'does not preserve the amenity of adjacent land and dwelling houses'.
The tribunal confirmed the refusal decisions.
